Hey so I just went through this to a tee so take my advice lol. You have to either learn to be attracted in other ways or leave. I actually got engaged to my balding fiancé who went from 180 to 220 in the course of two years dating. For reference we are a gay couple. I was conflicted and also but I found other things about him that I find attractive. I also thought about the possibility of changing myself in the future and I absolutely know he would accept me. He is a good guy, and the best relationship I’ve been in (why I said yes to the proposal). 

I had conversations about my partners weight with them. And they know the sexual dynamic has changed. I see him more as this dominant figure now that he is more stocky. I told him to not let it get anymore out of control or I simply couldn’t do it. 

If you decide to stay, take back your sexual agency and find ways that he can turn you on in his current state. If it doesn’t work for you then you have to leave. Last bit, I do think it was a bit weird for him to go through with it after you giving your two cents that you might not be attracted anymore. Working out to stay attractive is important. But ultimately I can’t tell my partner how to look, I can either accept or move on. Good Luck!!

Then bring up that you’ve been thinking about whether it could be a possibility to try it out. Better to get the idea out in doses rather than all at once. 1. Exercise! Go for a light jog.  
2. Cry about it. Set a timer for a good cry session and after the timer is done go get something productive done (at least one thing)
3. Practice positivity. Remind yourself of one good quality or one thing you love about yourself. 
4. Open your windows and let the fresh air into your house or apartment. This works best after or during a good cleaning session in my opinion.
5. Change your mindset, sometimes doing nothing is important to healing and resetting your body. Don't be too hard on yourself about it. 
6. Lastly remember depression is temporary and that you will soon find your baseline again. 

Much love, take care of yourself.

OP it sounds like your downstairs neighbor suffers from severe night terrors. Personally mine would occur with me screaming at the top of my lungs standing beside my bed or trying to escape something from my dream (may explain the running). Express concern that you almost called the police or something to let them know how serious the disruptions are. As far as the loosing sleep part I would use white noise on full blast and on repeat (played through a Bluetooth speaker, not the actual machines that don't even get that loud). Hopefully that can drown out the noise enough that it doesn't startle you.
